assignedTasks.empty: No open tasks assigned to you.

cli.title: Genwork CLI
cli.description: Commands to run and operate the instance. They work from any folder inside the Genwork repository.

commands.up: Starts everything: database, API, and web app (the web app keeps running in the terminal).
commands.api: Starts the gateway, the core API, and the modules, with their database, migrations, worker, and mail catcher.
commands.web: Runs the web app dev server in the terminal.
commands.auth: Creates an administrator (asks for e-mail, name, and password).
commands.modules: Chooses the installed modules: checked ones stay installed, unchecked ones are removed.
commands.down: Stops the database, API, and mail catcher. Data is kept.

github.title: GitHub
github.intro: Connect GitHub so pull requests move tasks: a pull request whose title or branch cites a task key moves the task when it is opened, when a review is requested, and when it is merged into a final branch. Each board chooses the columns in its settings.
github.connectDescription: Genwork creates a private GitHub App for this installation with read-only access to pull requests. GitHub asks you to confirm, then you choose the repositories.
github.organizationDescription: Leave it empty to create the App on your personal account. A private App can only be installed on the account that owns it, so enter the organization that owns the repositories.
github.installNext: The App {{app}} was created. Install it on the repositories whose pull requests should move tasks.
github.disconnectDescription: Genwork deletes the App's credentials and stops moving tasks. Board settings are kept. The App still exists on GitHub: delete it in its settings there.
github.unreadableTitle: The GitHub credentials can no longer be read
github.unreadableDescription: The encryption key of this installation changed, so Genwork cannot verify GitHub's events. Disconnect, delete the old App on GitHub, and connect again.
github.unreachableDescription: GitHub delivers events to {{url}}, which is not a public HTTPS address. Tasks only move once GitHub can reach Genwork over the internet.

errors.stateInvalid: This connection attempt expired or was started by someone else. Start again.
errors.codeInvalid: GitHub did not accept the code it sent back; it may have expired. Start again.
errors.callbackMissing: GitHub did not send the information needed to finish. Start again.

settings.title: GitHub
settings.description: Which column a task moves to when a pull request citing it changes. Tasks only move forward, and never again after a merge moved them.
settings.notConnected: GitHub is not connected, so these settings have no effect yet.
settings.opened: When a pull request is opened
settings.merged: When merged into a final branch
settings.keyHint: The pull request title or branch must contain the task key, such as {{example}}.
settings.finalBranchesDescription: Merges into these branches move the task. Names are case-sensitive.
